meta_title: obleek — expense tracker that detects your payments
meta_description: obleek turns your bank’s payment notifications into transactions: tap to confirm, instead of typing. Expenses, income, transfers, debts — your whole budget in one app.
og_description: obleek turns your bank’s payment notifications into transactions: tap to confirm, instead of typing.
twitter_description: Detects payments from your bank notifications. Budget, debts, 160+ currencies.
jsonld_description: obleek turns your bank’s payment notifications into transactions: tap to confirm, instead of typing. Expenses, income, transfers, debts — your whole budget in one app. The feed groups entries by day, and each account’s ledger shows the running balance after every entry.
hero_lede: obleek turns your bank’s payment notifications into transactions: tap to confirm, instead of typing.
feature1_p: Every transaction lands in one feed. See what came in, what went out, and where it went — by category, by month, over the last six months.
feature1_li1: Income, expenses, transfers, and debts in one feed
feature1_li2: Daily activity heatmap and category breakdowns
feature2_p: Build your own category tree, nested up to four levels deep, each with its own icon. Reorder by dragging, archive what you no longer use, and keep expense and income categories separate.
feature2_li1: Nested categories, up to 4 levels deep
feature2_li2: Archive instead of losing your history
feature3_h2: Your cards, cash and debts in one app.
feature3_p: Cash, debit and credit cards, deposits — every account lives in one list, in its own currency, rolled up into a single total. Track what you owe and what’s owed to you alongside everything else.
feature3_li1: Cash, cards and deposits as accounts
feature3_li2: Track money you’ve lent or borrowed
feature3_li3: One balance, broken down by currency
feature3_li4: Archive an account without losing its history
cta_p: Explore with sample data first, or start tracking right away.
app_heat_prompt: Tap a day to see its activity.
app_depth_note: Drag to reorder. Categories can be nested up to 4 levels deep.
flow_p: Turn on transaction detection and pick which banking apps obleek may watch. It picks out the amount, currency, merchant, and the last four digits of the card. You get a notification, tap it, check the details, and save.
trust1_p: Anything obleek doesn’t already recognize is analyzed on the device, never on a server.
trust2_p: Notification text is never stored and never leaves your phone.
trust3_h3: Off until you turn it on
trust3_p: The feature stays off until you turn it on, and you choose every app it watches.
trust4_p: Each detected payment waits for your confirmation before it becomes a transaction.
feature2_li3: Tags, places and people on any transaction
feature3_li5: 160+ currencies, plus BTC, ETH, USDT and USDC
flow_note: obleek ships with the notification formats of 80+ banking and payment apps.
unique1_p: Transfers work between accounts in different currencies: send 1,000 USD from one and receive 900 EUR in the other.
unique2_p: Nest subcategories, give each one an icon, and drag them into the order you think in.
unique3_p: Log what you lent and what you borrowed. Every person has a running balance in each currency and the full history behind it.
unique_rest: Everything else works like a regular expense tracker: recurring payments, search, tags, export, a PIN lock, and nine languages.
